# Dragos Pop

> MSc Data Science graduate with six years of experience using data to solve real-world problems, working across Amsterdam, Singapore, and Melbourne on AI and Data Engineering projects for renewable energy retailing, transportation, and healthcare.

This site is Dragos Pop's personal portfolio showcasing projects in Data Engineering, ML & AI, BI, CI/CD, and Optimization.

## Pages

- [Home / Portfolio overview](https://dragos-pop.github.io/index.html): Full list of projects in inverse chronological order
- [Certifications](https://dragos-pop.github.io/certifications.html)
- [Software Toolkit](https://dragos-pop.github.io/software-toolkit.html)

## Projects

- [Invoicing Pipeline Lite](https://dragos-pop.github.io/invoicing-pipeline-lite.html): Dagster pipeline that reads monthly contractor hours from an Excel workbook, generates a branded PDF invoice, and emails it to the client
- [Grid Capacity Pipeline](https://dragos-pop.github.io/grid-capacity-pipeline.html): Pipeline that fetches a byte-encoded PDF report via API, parses tables, loads them into Snowflake via S3, and refreshes dbt models powering a Holistics dashboard
- [Selective Dagster Code Location Deployment with GitHub Actions](https://dragos-pop.github.io/selective-cl-deployment.html): GitHub Actions job that dynamically selects Dagster code locations for rollout based on PR labels
- [Generating Music from Raw MIDI](https://dragos-pop.github.io/generating-music.html): GPT-like transformers trained on HPC to generate music from raw MIDI
- [Goodreads Book Rating Prediction](https://dragos-pop.github.io/book-rating-prediction.html): Predicting review ratings of books on Goodreads
- [Ranking Hotel Listings on Expedia](https://dragos-pop.github.io/ranking-hotel-listings.html): Ranking hotel listings by booking likelihood
- [Caged Shipment Prediction](https://dragos-pop.github.io/classifying-held-shipments.html): LightGBM model classifying whether a shipment will be caged, built for FedEx Express
- [Dashboard Hypertension Plus](https://dragos-pop.github.io/app-dashboard.html): Dashboard tracking engagement and outcomes for OMRON Healthcare's hypertension app
- [Automation of Engagement System](https://dragos-pop.github.io/engagement-automation.html): Automated email targeting system for OMRON Healthcare's Hypertension Plus app users
- [Berth Allocation Problem within Port of Amsterdam](https://dragos-pop.github.io/berth-allocation-optimization.html): Optimization study on berth allocation strategies for the Port of Amsterdam
